question: Should maintainers wait for this external fork to be refreshed with proof, or sponsor a credited replacement branch for the linked hook accountId bug?
rationale: The bug remains valid, but this fork is conflicting, maintainer edits are disabled, and live proof is missing, so automation cannot safely choose or execute the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor Current-Main Port
options.body: Open or adopt a credited replacement branch that ports the accountId fix to current hook and SourceDeliveryPlan seams, then require live proof before merge.

options.title: Wait For Contributor Refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, enable maintainer edits, remove the changelog edit, add docs, and provide live multi-account proof on this PR.

options.title: Close After Replacement Lands
options.body: Keep this PR open until a proof-positive replacement is merged, then close it as superseded by that landed fix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Current-Main Port
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a credited replacement branch that ports the accountId fix to current hook and SourceDeliveryPlan seams, then require live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent hook-specific history and was already asked for review in the PR discussion.
